speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your postpartum check-in. I see you are experiencing fever and abdominal tenderness; could you tell me how many days post-delivery you are and how you delivered?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Pyelonephritis with possible Atonic Uterus or Subinvolution.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, CBC with Differential, and Serum Creatinine.
